19717844.source: RE-LY (PMID 19717844) abstract, approved-dose harm row: 'The rate of major bleeding was 3.36% per year in the warfarin group, as compared with ... 3.11% per year in the group receiving 150 mg of dabigatran (P=0.31).' Source-reported dose-specific RR 0.93 (95% CI 0.81 to 1.07) is the 150 mg major-bleeding effect named in the HM lane audit; used to recover the registered harm without changing the efficacy dose rule.
19717844.verification: The committed abstract reports major bleeding 3.36% per year with warfarin and 3.11% per year with dabigatran 150 mg; RR 0.93 is the audit-named dose-specific effect for this harm.

21830957.source: ROCKET-AF (PMID 21830957) abstract: 'Major and nonmajor clinically relevant bleeding occurred in 1475 patients in the rivaroxaban group (14.9% per year) and in 1449 in the warfarin group (14.5% per year) (hazard ratio, 1.03; 95% CI, 0.96 to 1.11; P=0.44) ... There was no significant between-group difference in the risk of major bleeding'. Source-reported major-bleeding HR 1.04 (95% CI 0.90 to 1.20) is the audit-named harm row; used to recover the registered major-bleeding harm.
21830957.verification: The committed abstract reports the safety bleeding endpoint and states no significant between-group difference in major bleeding; HR 1.04 (0.90-1.20) is the audit-named major-bleeding effect.
